# Freestyle Studio 1.3
- Preview your Shorts with YouTube, Instagram Reels, or TikTok controls while filming. Choose the platform before recording; show or hide the overlay while filming. - The preview has breathing room above and below, with app navigation below the recorded frame. - Choose **Edit profile…** to save a handle, display name, and profile photo or logo for each platform. Profiles stay on your Mac. - App overlays and profile details are preview-only and do not appear in saved video.
Platform layouts are representative and may vary by phone and app version. This release adds local preview profiles; it does not connect social accounts.

Curtain Call is now **Freestyle Studio**.
The new name appears in the app, menus, windows, and download. Your existing recordings, scripts, preferences, and workspaces stay in place.
Existing installations continue to receive updates through the same update feed.

Keep your script still until you are ready to read. The new **Auto-scroll on record** button in Studio Script Settings remembers your choice and preserves your reading position when turned off.
Switch between **Camera**, **Screen**, and **Both** during a recording. The controls stay beneath Stop, and Control–Option–1, 2, and 3 switch views from other apps. Returning to Both keeps your camera framing.
Choose your camera and screen before recording. Curtain Call disables views whose sources are unavailable during a take.

Curtain Call records screen and camera videos on macOS 14 or later.
- Record unscripted walkthroughs in Freestyle or use Studio with a script. - Studio’s No script option now keeps a separate video title and leaves script settings inactive. - Studio and Freestyle use the same selected microphone input and recording gain. This fixes quiet Freestyle audio with multi-input interfaces such as the Scarlett. - Use Check level and speak normally for five seconds to set a fixed recording gain.
Download the ZIP, unzip it, and move Curtain Call to Applications. On first use, allow the camera, microphone and screen-recording access you need.
This release supports Apple Silicon and Intel Macs and includes automatic update checks. Recordings stay local; Google Drive sign-in is not included in this release.
